answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43630 Country: India Title: Dream Question: After the death of my father I saw that I came from somewhere and I am seeing my dead body in front of my house and father is standing near my body. Then he put my body in his hand and brings it inside home and said "now get up son it is not your turn to go this time I am going" and he died and I was alive. Please let me know what is the meaning of this? Answer ID: 43630 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 158/122/H=1434) Ma-shaAllah, it is nice dream. The meaning is that your father shall get benefit from your good deeds, duas and isal-e-sawab in barzakh and hereafter, in-shaAllah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
